channel.title: E School News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from E School News (eschoolnews.com)

item.title: New research challenges fears about AI in the classroom
item.description: Rather than replacing student thinking, when teachers design and guide AI experiences, the technology is most often used to deepen critical thinking and strengthen instruction

item.title: Mis-identifying “504-only” students
item.description: Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act, which prohibits discrimination against students and other individuals with disabilities, is far less visible than the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) in school districts.

item.title: Building pathways to purpose: How we can empower students for an uncertain future
item.description: One day, something clicked for Jacob Griffin's students. Mr. Griffin, a teacher at the NAF Academy of Engineering at Southeast Raleigh High School in North Carolina, found that students who had previously been going through the motions were coming to class more engaged, more driven, and more confident about the potential futures that lay beyond high school.

item.title: 5 high-frequency and irregular word teaching strategies rooted in the Science of Reading
item.description: When students learn to read in the early elementary years, developing phonemic awareness, decoding skills, and blending typically take priority. Another essential component of fluent reading, however, is learning to read high-frequency and irregular words.

item.title: What’s in and out in literacy instruction for 2026
item.description: The conversation around literacy instruction has reached a turning point. After decades of debate, we're finally seeing a broad consensus around evidence-based practices--but the challenge now is moving from understanding what works to actually implementing it in classrooms.

item.title: A quicker climb up the literacy mountain: Why rigor and efficiency matter in early reading
item.description: In early literacy, the goal is simple but urgent: Help students become independent readers and writers. Every instructional decision we make either moves them closer to that goal or keeps them circling the mountain instead of climbing it.

item.title: A new PLC model that builds collective efficacy and fights teacher burnout
item.description: In schools across the country, teacher turnover and burnout have reached crisis levels. Educators are stretched thin, often working in isolation, and many professional learning communities (PLCs) fail to deliver meaningful results.

item.title: New CoSN report underscores importance of intentional, reliable edtech use
item.description: A purposeful commitment to responsible edtech use--and to professional development for teachers--is necessary to ensure edtech is innovative and transformational, according to CoSN's annual 2026 Driving K-12 Innovation Report.

item.title: Tips and tools to effectively differentiate learning for student engagement
item.description: As a paraprofessional for over 3 years and going on my 5th year as a certified special education resource teacher, I’ve learned that no two learners are ever quite the same.

item.title: Celebrating Teachers: Nominate Outstanding Educators for Crystal Apple Awards
item.description: School Specialty, a leading provider of learning environments, instructional solutions, and supplies for preK-12 education, is proud to celebrate outstanding educators with its 12th annual Crystal Apple Awards.
